excerpt.zh: 所有[target.capital_scope.GetName]的[target.GetSpeciesName]重要领袖都被我们的密探调包了。现在渗透人员正在巩固我们在[target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]的进展。是时候采取行动了。
excerpt.en: All [target.GetSpeciesName] leaders of significance on [target.capital_scope.GetName] have been replaced by our own agents. Infiltration cells are now consolidating our efforts on the [target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. The time to act is upon us.

texts.zh: 所有[target.capital_scope.GetName]的[target.GetSpeciesName]重要领袖都被我们的密探调包了。现在渗透人员正在巩固我们在[target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]的进展。是时候采取行动了。
texts.en: All [target.GetSpeciesName] leaders of significance on [target.capital_scope.GetName] have been replaced by our own agents. Infiltration cells are now consolidating our efforts on the [target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. The time to act is upon us.

texts.zh: 我们目前在[target.capital_scope.GetName]有数以千计的秘密特工，并且渗透了[root.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]的各方各面。一些特工已在当地的权力体系中升居高位，并利用自身的职位影响力为其他特工提供便利。
texts.en: Our covert operatives on [target.capital_scope.GetName] now number in the thousands, and have infiltrated every facet of the [root.target.capital_scope.GetPlanetHabitat]. Several have ascended to leading positions in the local hierarchy, and are already wielding the influence of their positions to benefit other agents.

texts.zh:
虽然我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]表面上有数以千计的特工，但进展始终缓慢。我们曾试图推翻一个由[target.GetName]组成的主要定居点，最终惨痛收场。有关特工都已牺牲或自裁。

多亏了一支潜伏小组的英勇之举，当局才没有找到尸体，未能识破我们在星球上的行动。
texts.en:
Although our operatives on the surface of [target.capital_scope.GetName] now number in the thousands, progress has been slow. An attempt to overthrow one of the major settlements comprising the [target.GetName] ended in disaster, and the death or self-termination of every agent involved.

It was only the heroic efforts of a sleeper cell that kept local authorities from recovering the bodies and exposing our work on the planet.

texts.zh:
在完全控制了[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]的政治高层之后，我们的渗透人员已经做好准备迎接首次接触小组的正式到访。

在新的行星首都举办的大型仪式上，所有[infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]领袖共同签署了[infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]立即并入[root.GetName]的请愿书。我们的外交大使很大度地接受了这一请求。公民们兴高采烈地走上街道，为他们的外星恩主欢呼着。
texts.en:
After achieving complete dominion over the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] political leadership, our infiltration cells paved the way for the arrival of a formal first contact unit.

In a lavish ceremony held at the planetary capital, our diplomatic envoy graciously accepted a petition signed by every world leader on [infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]. The document calls for the immediate annexation of their [infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] into the [root.GetName]. Jubilant citizens now crowd the streets, cheering their alien benefactors.

texts.zh: 在[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]政治领袖之中立足后，我们的渗透单元为第一次接触单元的正式到来铺平了道路。在行星首都的一场恰如其分的仪式上，我们的特使谦逊地接受了一份由[infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]星球个领袖签署的陈情书。文件展示了将[infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]吞并如[root.GetName]的计划。许多居民前来夹道欢迎他们的新外星施恩者。
texts.en: After gaining a foothold over the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] political leadership, our infiltration cells paved the way for the arrival of a formal first contact unit. In a modest ceremony at the planetary capital, our diplomatic envoy humbly accepted a petition signed by the world leaders of [infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]. The document lays out plans for the annexation of their [infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] into the [root.GetName]. Many citizens welcome their new alien benefactors.

texts.zh:
我们对[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]政治领导层的渗透并不像我们被灌输的那样彻底。在起先渗透主要国家失败后，我们尝试在一些较小的政权中发动政变。即便如此我们也还是未能获得民众的支持。

我们已经从[infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]撤回了所有还健在的特工。当地居民显然会在未来几年内保持警惕。
texts.en:
Our infiltration of the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] political leadership was not as complete as we had been led to believe. After initially failing to infiltrate their major nations, we attempted a coup within a minor power. Yet even there, the people didn't want us.

We have extracted all our surviving operatives from [infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]. The inhabitants are sure to be on alert for years to come.

tooltips.zh: 我们在5年之内无法再发起任何[From.GetName]任务。
tooltips.en: We will be unable to launch any new [From.GetName] missions for 5 years.

texts.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员收到消息称我们干涉[pre_ftl_country.GetName]自然发展。他们告知我们这毫无疑问违反了不予干涉法案，无论我们的本意如何。

[Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
texts.en:
Officials from the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have received word of our interference in the natural development of the [pre_ftl_country.GetName]. They have informed us that this is a clear violation of the Non-Interference Act, regardless of our intentions.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law for the next ten years. In addition, we have been issued with a hefty fine.

texts.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员们裁定，无论我们的用意为何，我们与[pre_ftl_country.GetName]的协议已经违反了平等相待法案。

[Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
texts.en:
Officials from the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have determined that our treatment of the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] is in violation of the Equal Standing Act, regardless of our intentions.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law for the next ten years. In addition, we have been issued with a hefty fine.

texts.zh: 渗透入[infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj]的政治领导层后，我方特工为第一次接触单元的到来铺平了道路。他们不打算举行任何仪式来庆祝我方外交使节的到达。不过，我方已与[infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]的领袖集团达成共识。他们的[infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]将被并入[root.GetName]。
texts.en: After infiltrating the [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] political leadership, our operatives have laid the ground for the arrival of a formal first contact unit. There will be no ceremony to mark the arrival of our diplomatic envoy. However, we have entered an agreement with the world leaders of [infiltrated_country_planet.GetName]. Their [infiltrated_country_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] will be annexed into the [root.GetName].
